İttifak var ama aslında şimdi eee perde arkasında böyle bir mesaj var. Yani Bahçe'nin konuşması alt metni bu aslında ama aynı zamanda ne? Şimdi biz Serkan abiyle konuştuk dedim abi sen ne diyorsun? Hani konuşamadık da bugün hiç Serkan abiyle dedim abi ne diyorsun ya? Ne diyeyim? Eray dedi bu şimdi ne de ya biz falcılara mı düşelim dedi ya abi hakikaten şimdi öyle bir açıklama yapıyor ki medyumlara mı danışalım falcılara mı düşelim ya bir şeyi açık net söyle ya bir şeye açık net söyle değil mi abi MHP1 ya ne demek istedin şimdi zivilyon tane şey bütün falcılar çıktı parlamenter sistem geliyor. Parlamenter sistem geldiği için aslında Bahçeli'e bir mesaj veriyor. diyor ki ya eee biz cumhurbaşkanlığı hükümet sisteminden yanayız. Parlamenter sisteminin gelmesine karşıyız. O yüzden MHP birinci parti yürütmede Erdoğan sözlerini kullandı Bahçeli. Mesela bu yorumu yapanlar var. Olabilir mi? Ol. Ama en nihayetinde abi yorum yapıyoruz yani. Tabii yorum ya. Hakikaten bizi böyle falcılara falan düşüyoruz yani. Medyumlara düşüyoruz ya. Kardeşim bir şeyi net söyleyin ya. Net söyleyin dedim. Ben MHP'nin veya Bahçeli'nin her açıklamasında, biz gazeteciyiz değil mi? Yani işimiz bizim kelimeyle, haber yazmayla MHP'nin her açıklamasında zaten okumak bir yarım saat, 45 dakika falan bir saat alabiliyor. Her açıklamada yeni bir kelime öğreniyorum mesela. >> Ya şimdi Serkan abi de di ya diyor ki hakikaten açık açık konuşun abi artık yeter. Bıktık ya bıktık abi artık yani. Nedir ya? Açık konuşun yani. Ne yani bak bugün bakıyorsun şimdi ABD'nin Irak'tan çekilmesi vesaire aslında onu da konuşacaktık. Neyse diğer yayınlarda da konuşuruz. Şimdi Mekke sözleşmesi, bizim Genelkurmay Başkanı acil koduyla bayraklarının oraya çağırılması, Mekke'de toplantı yapılması ve eee Türk askerinin Mekke'ye gideceği direkt Suudi Arabistan'la birlikte Yemen'e karşı mücadele edeceği işte tırnak içerisinde mücadele bir ittifak kuracağı iddiaları daha meclisten bak tezkere falan bile geçmemiş. Hiçbir şey geçmemiş. Bunları biz yatıyoruz kalkı konuşuyoruz. Şimdi bu kadar çok ciddi sorunlarla karşı karşıyayız. Terörist başına statü veriliyor. PYD devletleştiriyor. Ya çıkın şurada direkt net açık konuşun ya. Yani artık bak bundan gerçekten yorulduk abi. Artık gerçekten yorulduk bak. Yani bu millet sizin ağzınızdan artık direkt net bir şey duysun. Tepkisini gösterir. Ama eee bakıyoruz eee bahsettiğimiz MHP'den veya Bahçeli'den bir açıklama geldiği zaman düşünüyoruz üzerine. Yani şunu mu dedi, bunu? 100 ihtimal çıkıyor belki. Dediğim gibi burada eee şeffaf olunması hem millet açısından eee hem de bizler açısından >> Evet. >> eee daha özetleyici olur. İşimize bakarız ya. Yani >> yani orada da onu söylemiş olalım. Yani bence orada hani Bahçe'nin açıklaması hem böyle biraz biz AKP'nin günahlarına da ortak değiliz deyip şimdi açılım masasında da aslında kendi eee ağırlığını da arttırmaya çalışıyor diğer yandan. Yani kuzu masaya sürüyor aslında. Diyor ki bak fondan sen bitik durumdasın. Ben sana artık kefil olmuyorum. O yüzden de artık mesela Öcalan'a statü deniyor değil mi? Gecikmiş bir şekilde yapılıyor aslında. Yapılıyor bugün de ama aylar sonra, yıllar sonra bu işi hızlandıralım derdinde Bahçeli. Burada da aslında masaya bir kozda sürüyor diğer yandan. Ama böyle bir bataklıkta zaten işte Öcalan'a statüelir zaten. Odur olay yani. Şimdi herkes şey yorumunu yapıyor ya Burakan. Şimdi bu fon kriziyle o ayukat çıktı ya. Ya herkes di bu devlet çökmüş ya. Günaydın ya abi ya. Biz ilk dedik ki bak Serkan abi çok önemli laf söyledi ya. dedi ki Öcalan'ın statü tartışmaların yapıldığı gün hatta Kızılcagu panellerinde de Veryansın TV yayınlarında şunu söyledi. items.transkript: Good morning. Good morning. Good  morning. Good morning to the beautiful  people of our beautiful country.  Starting before the birds have even had  their breakfast. Today is Thursday,  October 8th. Sometimes a cartoon is  enough to explain the current agenda.  It draws a cartoon like this. It tells  the whole story, and you are amazed at  how these things are explained without  needing a single word. Now, the  Felicity Party's social media and video  team is truly very successful. They  prepared a video, and we are certainly  going to talk about it. Of course we  will, but they summarized the whole  agenda in a video that wasn't even a  minute long. Now, Eren will show it to  us. Actually, this is exactly what  happened. It went like this. First,  Cemil Tugay—you know, the Mayor of  Izmir Metropolitan Municipality—was  elected from the CHP. He switched to  the AKP yesterday. He was pinned with  the badge. Just before that, the AKP  had released a video. Where flowers  were blooming on mountains of trash,  and they used the "Izmir March" for it.  This video drew a lot of reactions and  occupied the agenda for a long time. In  response, the Felicity Party showed the  same trash mountains turning into  flowers, but then something else  unfolds. They point to "Foncu Fatma,"  Emre Tezmen, Erdin Özel, and other new  fraud artists; you know, they scammed  hundreds of thousands, millions of  citizens, stole their money, and they  were very important political names in  the AKP. It emphasizes them, and this  video was talked about a lot.  Deservedly so. I truly applaud them as  well. I congratulate them. The Felicity  Party team really produced a very  beautiful video. But of course, the  point that formed the source of the  video was the AKP taking Izmir for the  first time in its history after 27  years. They could never achieve this  through elections. The AKP pushed very  hard in the elections. They made Binali  Yıldırım a candidate at one point.  They nominated the names they thought  would be most effective in Izmir and  made huge promises. They made very,  very big promises. They tried a ton of  methods to wear down their opponents,  including cutting off all their  resources and even seizing their  properties. They didn't succeed, but if  there is someone on the inside with a  key in their hand, they unlocked that  door and the AKP took Izmir. They  finally took Izmir. They experienced  such enthusiasm. They were expressing  this very clearly, just like in that  video. Until the very last minute,  there were no clear statements from the  new party about whether Cemil Tugay  would switch or not. Because Cemil  Tugay had even criticized the new party  during the CHP turmoil process. He had  even criticized Özgür Özel's team.  He had resigned. He didn't listen to  anyone, but he said he would join the  new party. Then he didn't join the new  party either. Since June 18th, he had  been independent; he had been serving  as an independent mayor for four months , and he had clashed with the AKP a lot . Especially when the central  government seized the "Profession  Factory" and other properties belonging  to the Izmir Metropolitan Municipality  through foundations, he had started  vigils and sit-in protests, and he was  known for his harsh rhetoric against  the AKP. He even had very harsh words  for those who joined the AKP, as well  as for the Mayor of Aydın Metropolitan  Municipality and the Mayor of Afyon. He  had very harsh words from the past. But  he himself joined the AKP. Look, it’s  so strange because I know him, and when  this allegation first came up, I  realized I didn't know him that well.  I’ve sat at the same table as him a  few times. I mean, I thought, "Could he  really do it?" and during this process,  I talked to everyone around him— district mayors, municipal council  members, and journalists in the region —ever since these claims first  surfaced. Their common opinion was  almost entirely the same. "No, he can't  possibly switch over here.""He couldn't  even walk down the street if he did  something like that; he just can’t."  I mean, it's impossible. "No way, that  will never happen," they were saying.  And Cemil Tugay did a 180-degree turn.  Completely backtracked on all those  statements. He is always talking about  tradition, ethics, and standing on  principle. Because he always talks  about principles. He talks about  determination and claims to be a fierce  opponent. An incredible turnaround. A  very sharp turnaround, indeed. He  turned so sharply that he became an AKP  member in a day—at jet speed. Eren  and I were even talking about it  yesterday. Eren said, "Man, no one can  act this well.""Was he an AKP supporter  all along?""Was he an AKP guy?" he  asked. I mean, he wasn't. I said, "How  could he be?" He wasn't. But some  people, especially those who lack their  own political worldview or ideology and  have serious flaws in their character,  adapt very quickly to the environment  they enter. They are like chameleons;  they immediately take the shape of  their surroundings. And that’s why  his speech was a bit surprising. Now, I  will ask Eren to play this speech with  audio. I mean, honestly, everyone was  like, "Wait, what's going on?" We  engage in politics to protect the  rights of the people, the farmers, and  the tradesmen. The AK Party is the  voice of the voiceless. These words are  the words of our great leader, our  President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, who  has left his mark on the last 25 years  of the Republic of Turkey. I mean,  isn't Eren right? He really is a good  actor, you have to admit that. And  there is also this. Everyone was  curious about his wife because he had  said, "My mother would disown me.""If I  join the AKP, my wife will divorce me."  He said that, but his wife doesn't seem  to be in the mood for a divorce. As you  can see on the screen, someone wrote on  social media that when he said "divorce ," he actually meant "rejoice." She  didn't divorce him; she rejoiced. When  he said divorce, he meant rejoice. They  rejoiced together, walked together,  posed together, and as you heard in the  previous remarks, he repeated it in  front of the cameras when he came out.  He continued to praise Erdoğan.  Erdoğan made a post on social media.  He supported him, and in one day, he  fully immersed himself in his role and  entered the AKP world. He entered the  AKP world. Now, naturally, he has  entered that AKP world. So, everyone is  wondering what the situation is in the  municipal council. First of all, the  New Party has 93 municipal council  members. AKP 38, CHP 33, independent 12 , MHP 7, BP 1. Now, of course, mayors  in Turkey have broad powers, but when  you look at the council, the New Party  clearly holds the majority. Don't be so  sure. Don't be so sure. Now Cemil Tugay  could place an order, and through  operations, 93 New Party council  members could be detained. They could  all be thrown in jail or something like  that. Let’s see, taking Izmir after  all these years was already Erdogan's  dream. He took Izmir through transfers.  But this doesn't pass now. This doesn't  count, actually. I mean, let’s all  say that together. It doesn't count,  Mr. Erdogan, it doesn't count. I mean,  winning at the ballot box is the real  issue; otherwise, winning through  transfers is limited to a person's  capacity to flip. I mean, it doesn't  count. If you can win at the ballot box , then everyone would say fair enough,  you won at the ballot box. But look,  Erdogan says it is the "protector of  the protectorless." You know, that is  Ataturk's quote. The Republic is the  protector of the protectorless. That is  how he defines the Republic. In the  early founding years of the Republic,  the founders of this country called  this land they established the  protector of the protectorless and  launched a development initiative.  Thousands, hundreds of thousands of  people are not robbed in such funds. I  mean, those who are robbed are the ones  without a protector. The ones who do  the robbing are the ones in charge of  the country, and to this...In a sense,  when you say that phrase, you should  actually be referencing the founders of  this country. Everyone thinks that way.  Look, don't forget these things. Part  of this is a political show. It is a  display of political power. It carries  a political goal. But never forget that  a significant part of it is motivated  by rent-seeking. Rent-seeking  motivation. Now, don't underestimate  this regarding Cemil Tugay either. Now,  the projects and plans that weren't  approved for Cemil Tugay will suddenly  be approved one after another. A huge  amount of rent will emerge. A very  large amount of rent will emerge. Very  large tenders will be issued for those  unapproved projects, and the looting  will continue from there. There was  also a reaction from the IYI Party. Ali  Mahir Basarir said to Cemil Tugay—you  know he's a plastic surgeon. He said he  should change his face. He can't walk  the streets of Izmir anymore. He said  he should at least change his face with  plastic surgery. Of course, the streets  also reacted in a way. Many citizens in  Izmir took to the streets and held  marches, but there were truly  extraordinary security measures. I mean , all the roads were blocked with  barriers. Those marching were not  allowed to gather. The police were  intervening immediately. Actually, we  have those images. Eren will show them  to you now. For example, the New Party  Izmir Provincial Chair, Cagtay Guc, was  dragged by the police. Because they  wanted to go to...The New Party members  wanted to go to the municipal building  to leave a black wreath, and the public  reacted. There were water cannons, and  we witnessed police interventions  everywhere in the side streets. People  were not allowed to gather. Now, look,  on one hand, this...While these  developments were ongoing, the actress  Berna Lacin—you know her—also  reacted. She sent a tweet and said, " Izmir was occupied before." She wrote,  "Don't be afraid." Then, reports  surfaced that an investigation had been  launched against Berna Lacin. Berna  Lacin said, "I posted this anyway,  absurd." I’ve stirred the pot. A  journalist friend said that less than  an hour after he wrote it, an  investigation was opened for the crime  of inciting the public to hatred and  hostility. But he said he honestly  assumed it was fake news. Then he  tweeted again. He said they had come to  take him into custody. They are  searching my house. I couldn't  understand what was happening. Now, you  may or may not like Aliç's views. You  may or may not like the tweet he wrote.  I mean In a country where "Fonzi Fatma"  can steal over 2 billion TL and not  even be questioned for 12 days, how are  we supposed to make sense of the police  showing up at Bernçi's house an hour  or an hour and a half after he tweeted,  and them searching his home? I mean,  they are even searching the house. And  they are saying they are taking him  into custody. Let's see what happens.  Are you going to arrest him for this  tweet? Because if you're arresting him  for this, you had Kadir Mısıroğlu,  right? I mean, someone the AKP side  really loved. He used to say things  like, "I wish the Greeks had won." No  one ever touched him. They applaud him,  they still hold commemorations for him  and things like that. They hold  ceremonies. But now, what is this about  taking someone into custody for saying  something like this? And they  immediately used the "inciting the  public to hatred" charge in the  statement. And a detention order was  issued immediately. Now, look here, I  think the AKP made a strategic error  with the transfer of Cemil Tugay.  Especially that video where they used  the Izmir March, it really touches on  the most sensitive points of society.  It creates a sense of stubbornness  there. When we were doing the broadcast  yesterday, when we saw that video, Eren  had said, "Normally, teams like  Galatasaray do this to Fener, or Fener  does that to them." He said it was like  hooliganism. I agree with Eren's  statement very much. This is a move  that could only be made to provoke the  other side, and it also contains a huge  political mistake. In a sense, you are  telling these people this: "You didn't  vote for me, but look, I took Izmir  anyway," you are saying. This  stubbornness, we've already seen this  stubbornness in Üsküdar. We saw it in  the Adalar. We are seeing this  stubbornness most recently in Ataşehir . I mean, there is now a government  that is stubborn with the public  everywhere you can think of—we saw it  in Istanbul—and now, in that video,  it has gone beyond just being stubborn  and has become a tableau that mocks the  public and displays a hooligan-like  approach toward them. Those who  prepared that video know what the Izmir  March means to those people, and they  should have been able to foresee what  the reaction would be. And now, look,  it's also a very critical thing for  Cemil Tugay. There is an intervention  at play here that takes away the right  to vote from these people, further  fueling this anger and hatred. And then  there's the fact that they are mocking  this. Look, there is this "Fonzi" thing , you know, there are fund scammers.  And there are also vote scammers. Cemil  Tugay is a vote scammer. I mean, how do  those fund people trick you? They say,  "You will make a profit.""Give me your  money.""Buy these shares I'm selling  you." This guy is also saying, "Vote  for me.""I am from the CHP, I am in the  opposition," he says. And then, just  like in a fund where all your shares  crash, he takes the money and leaves.  And this steals all your votes, takes  them down, and sends them to the AKP.  So, this person is essentially a vote  profiteer. Now, you take that and place  it into a massive, infuriating picture  that includes both his own term and the  terms of opposition municipalities. And  let me state this, look, let me  emphasize this point. Cemil Tugay may  have praised Erdoğan a great deal. He  might have said nice things about  Erdoğan, like calling him the " protector of the unprotected" or "our  President." But Erdoğan knows very  well that he doesn't actually think  that way. Everyone around him knows he  doesn't think that way either. He only  says it like that; we know him. We know  it. Everyone knows what they said about  Erdoğan, right? What they said about  the AKP and the harsh things they said  just a short while ago. Conscience is  not something that changes in a single  day. Your interests might change in a  single day. You might turn 180 degrees  in a single day. But Mr. Erdoğan,  Cemil Tugay may speak like that to your  face, but his actual opinion is not  that. His views are that you have  destroyed this country, ruined it, that  you hold hatred against Izmir, that  you’ve stripped Izmir of all its  resources, and left it helpless—that  is the mindset behind it. At the very  least, that is what he uses as his  excuse. But the words of praise  directed at you are certainly not  sincere. And by doing this, through  this politics of transfers, Erdoğan  isn't just striking a blow to the  opposition, nor is the result merely  destroying the voter's belief that the  government can be changed through  elections. A great poison is being  injected into all of politics. It’s  implying that politics is just this  professional game. They have no  feelings, no ideology, no worldview, no  cause—nothing at all. They all twist  and change as they please, and this  will harm the AKP as well. It will  destroy society's trust in politics  entirely, and society is truly far  ahead of them on this issue. You will  see that there is a serious reaction  from society against this, and even a  reaction within the AKP base after a  while. There is a very, very important  development regarding the fund scandal.  Yesterday, Cevdet Yılmaz gave a  presentation at the Parliament. He, the  Vice President, made a presentation to  the Parliament on how payments would be  made to the victims of this fund  scandal. During this presentation, IYI  Party Izmir MP Ümit Özlale—you know , he had previously prepared a plan  regarding these fund victims and how to  resolve their grievances. He had  presented the IYI Party's plan. He  asked a very important question. Look,  let's watch. Eren will now air it for  us. Did a current minister put in 1  million and take out 830 million? Did  another current minister come out with  170 million lira? Did your private  secretary have money in the closed fund  or not? I am not making any accusations  in any way. I am asking you three  questions for you to investigate.  Regards. >> Now, look, Ümit Özlale made a truly  massive claim. Let's underline this;  let me repeat it as well. Let's  underline it. He says, look: He is  talking about a minister in the cabinet , a minister currently in the cabinet.  He says there is a minister in the  cabinet who is an investor in the fund,  and that he invested 470 million in his  father's name and withdrew 830 million.  This is incredibly huge. He doubled his  money, that is. 830 million, imagine a  minister with 830 million TL. And he  says there is a minister involved in  this fund fraud. Look, he continues.  Did another minister leave the fund  with 170 million liras before this fund  crisis erupted? Two ministers. He is  talking about two ministers. He says, " I'm not just leaving you under  suspicion," he says. I mean, he is  talking there, saying things about it.  "I asked three basic questions," he  says. "There is no accusation," he says . He says, "Did your chief of staff  have money in the compass closed fund  or not?""I asked this," he says. Three  questions. Now, this question is being  asked. Look, regarding the chief of  staff, look, aren't two questions very  important? There is a very critical  question regarding two ministers. Two  ministers who are profiteering in the  cabinet, meaning two ministers who are  fund scammers. He doesn't respond to  this. Cevdet doesn't speak at all about  those two ministers, but he responds to  the part about his own chief of staff  by getting angry at Ümit Özdag. He  says, "If everyone who invests is  guilty, let's send them all to court."" That's not how it works," he says. He  states that his own chief of staff,  Fatih Kilinc, invested 7 million liras  and suffered a huge loss in the fund.  He says, "He gathered 7 million from  his circle and invested it." He came  and told me. "When this incident blew  up, our money also got stuck.""I had  invested 7 million.""Along with a group  of friends.""Uh, I had collected the  money.""We are currently experiencing a  huge loss," he said. "And I, uh, he is  someone who is a victim," he said.  Cevdet Yilmaz even lashed out, saying,  "Are you accusing all the victims then? " Mr. Cevdet, your chief of staff  entered the fund, he put in money, just  let it be a topic of discussion, don't  get so angry. Everyone is wandering  around in funds. The entire AKP is  swarming in these funds like this. So  if your chief of staff was swarming  around there too, it's a valid question . Please, don't get angry, just answer.  He said, "I will do what is necessary."  He said, "If there were such a thing,  if they were scammers." But he didn't  say anything regarding the ministers.  He didn't say, "My brother, what are  you lying about?" regarding those  allegations about the two ministers.  Now, one of the breaking news  developments. We learned it last night.  We learned it from our sources as well.  When we heard this allegation, we asked  our sources immediately. It is said  that these two ministers are known by  the new party and will be announced by  party spokesperson Zeynel Emre after  the MYK meeting on Monday. They say  they will announce it. Two ministers in  the cabinet. Now, we were talking about  Ponzi Fatma. You know who Ponzi Fatma  is with at the AKP headquarters? Her  name came up together with Hayati  Yazici. Hayati Yazici's son, Mustafa  Yazici, also entered the fund business.  He was even skilled at preying on  debtors. It turns out he was collecting  money from there. Even a former BRSA  vice president was his partner. He even  went and got a digital bank license. He  set up a 3 billion TL business.  Wherever this money comes from, however  they find these funds. Then Mustafa  Yazici's partner committed suicide, you  know. They say he committed suicide,  that is. But we don't know if he really  committed suicide? Did he leave a note?  Did he leave a letter? They say he shot  himself with a gun in his vehicle. But  is there something else to this  incident? Didn't this man leave any  letter at all? Didn't he send a message  to anyone? I mean, maybe he didn't make  any confessions? Is there nothing like  that? Or is it really suicide, or was  he silenced? Is it murder? These  questions never end. When there's no  transparency, these questions never end , and now the fund is entering a deadly  phase. It is entering a deadly phase.  It doesn't end there. There is also  Nihat Zeybekci. Again, a deputy  chairman at the AKP headquarters. He is  also one of the closest names to AKP  leader Erdogan. And now they say two  ministers in the cabinet are involved.  If this is also true, meaning if there  are truly two ministers in the cabinet,  and one of these ministers invests 470  million—look, the minister has 470  million liras and invests it. Who has  that? The owner of ETS is involved.  Maybe the Minister of Culture and  Tourism has that 470 million liras, or  if someone else has it, they withdrew  830 million TL, you know. I mean, look  at the money he hit. He hit more than  400 million TL. I mean, the question is , another minister withdrew with 170  million liras. The whole cabinet, the  entire AKP is in the fund, you know, in  the fund. Why did they name the fund  Tera or something, AKP? It would have  been much better if they had named it  AKP. There was no need for that at all.  Now, uh, also, of course, when you look  at it, Eray, can you play the Saadet  Party thing again? Its video. Look,  this is exactly what the incident is,  actually. I mean, this is the agenda of  the incident. It also connects with  Izmir. The New Party did a similar  thing. Now let's take a look at the New  Party's video too. We will watch a  similar version of what they  constructed. And now we will talk more.  This fund is not just a place where  money is added to money, friends. It is  the world's largest washing machine.  The largest washing machine. Now, the  New Party couldn't ask the Saadet Party  either. First the Saadet Party did it,  then the New Party did it, and the  emphasis there, meaning Terolding and  that this activity is not just fraud,  and Ozgur Ozel actually emphasized this  very strongly in his speech. That  speech is already on it. His voice is  over the video. He has words to the  effect that this is Turkey's, perhaps  the world's, largest washing machine,  meaning money laundering activity. Look , I have been trying to underline this  since the beginning, since the  beginning of this scandal. I am  constantly saying this. This is not  just a scandal where people were  defrauded. This is truly a very, very  large money laundering operation. I  mean, very serious resources are  required to inflate these stocks. I  mean, when those funds are closed, when  they are closed to the public, a very  serious money traffic is required to  inflate those stocks. Those funds  should already be circulating in  recorded accounts, and that is when the  heist will take place. Meaning, it will  go public, people will see the rise in  the rate, rush in, and then people will  be scammed and swindled. So, when you  look at it, the actual mission is the  25%share of money laundering in the  world. In that fund, at the same time,  there is a massive amount of illegal  betting money, drug money, corruption  money; every type of off-the-books  money you can think of can be laundered  there. This is a very large-scale  activity. A very major money laundering  operation. The New Party also  emphasizes this in its reference  following the Saadet Party's video. Now , if a real investigation is launched  into this, we might encounter documents  proving that Turkey has been turned  into the world's largest money  laundering hub. We could encounter them  very clearly. Now, there is also this  situation on the other hand. Fatma  Betül Sayan Kaya, "Fonzi" Fatma. The  development regarding her was finally —finally, look—they hid it for 12  days, looking us right in the eye. The  police didn't move at lightning speed,  breaking down her door like they did  with Berna Aliçin. On the contrary,  the prosecutor's office waited. They  waited for a very long time. They even  waited for her to return the money. And  finally, we learned that they summoned  them for a statement, and they came to  give it. At the Çağlayan Courthouse,  Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband  İlyas Kaya gave their statements. They  gave their statements. While they were  giving statements, someone else arrived  at the same time. That is also very  interesting. Erdin Özel, that is,  Erdin Özel was brought from prison  where he is detained to give a  statement for the second time, and he  was brought exactly while they were  there. They gave statements for an hour  and a half, and I can tell you this  about the statement. They mocked our  intelligence. They mocked the entire  public. It was a statement process  where they mocked all of us. Now, of  course, what was asked? It lasted an  hour and a half. We know that if there  are Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality  investigations, or opposition-related  investigations, the most striking  information is served up immediately. I  mean, their homes are raided at dawn as  part of operations. The footage is  published. Slanders are cast against  them in the headlines. All kinds of  oppression are carried out. They are  put in custody, then in prison, held  for days, and so on. And the most  private information about them is  served up immediately. Now, in this  investigation, we see this. The  statements are not leaking, friends.  The statements are not leaking. Only  very small notes of information are  coming through. We still haven't  learned what questions were asked to  Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya. Look, a  statement was taken. We don't exactly  know what was asked of İlyas Kaya. We  only have some clues in our hands. We  are trying to find our way from those  clues. Now, for this, let's first look  at the statements. It is useful to take  a look at the statements a bit. And we  also can't learn this. We can't learn  Erdin Özel's statement either; it  surely can't be a coincidence that  Erdin Özel was brought there on the  same day. Because you know they did  this business together; remember, even  the photos of them attending events  together were published. But since  Fatma Betül Sayan was not taken into  custody, she destroyed the evidence.  She deleted the photos with Erdin Özel  from her Instagram account; by April 8,  the day she deleted the photos, they  had already made that 163 million TL  purchase in the fund. They were  protected so blatantly. And they even  said, "Return the money." Why are they  allowing them to return the money? Do  you know why the CMB doesn't file a  criminal complaint beforehand? Because  if the CMB files a criminal complaint,  they have to pay double. They would  have to pay 4.4 billion TL. They  already pulled off the heist, didn't  they? Instead, they are just waiting.  They are not being touched. They are  well-connected, blue-blooded. No matter  where the connections lead, we will see  this story to the end. Actually, they  couldn't even reach "Fonzi Fatma." It  leads to a point that protects them.  Now, they have given statements as  suspects. In these statements, well,  sometimes, look, sometimes statements  aren't taken to clarify an event. I  will only say this. I will only say  this much. After giving the money back,  after making them return the funds, all  digital materials, meetings with  lawyers, everything is destroyed and  wiped. Then they come and give their  statements. Now he says in his  statement, uh, the Kaya couple,  regarding their transactions in Özata  Shipping shares, uh, İlyas Kaya says,  "I bought approximately 150,000 lots of  Özata Shipping shares in April 2026."  He says he sold a portion of the shares  in August and the rest in September.  Exactly at the time of the heist. I  mean, he buys when the stock is at its  lowest, and it goes to the peak. At the  peak, he sells and leaves; boom, the  stock crashes. The stock crashes. At  that moment, he has already collected  the small investor's money, he's taken  it. He invested a portion of the money  from the sale into funds via Halk  Yatırım and Tere Yatırım for a  short term. It went to other funds as  well. Then he stated that the  transactions were in line with  regulations and that he did not perform  any manipulative actions. Meaning he  says, "I just saw it," he says, "I just  played in the funds," he says, "I  didn't do anything manipulative at all. " He also says it's in line with the  regulations. "What's wrong with that?"  he says. Claiming there was no outside  direction for his investments, Kaya  stated that after the investigation  became public, he felt a sense of moral  discomfort and transferred the gains  from his investments to the account  specified by the TMSF. Why are you  treating us like we're so stupid? What  makes you think we are this stupid? We  don't deserve this. I mean, as a  country, we truly don't deserve this. I  mean, how did you come to such a  conclusion? How do you arrive at the  conclusion that "these people are this  stupid"? Why are you insulting us? Why  are you belittling us? Look, there was  nothing irregular. Nobody directed them . They didn't get any inside  information either. They just felt it.  He just felt it, my friend. What does  he say? He felt a moral discomfort. The  public finds out after the incident  breaks. That's when he returned the  money. Actually, returning the money  means: "I admit my guilt." Meaning, "I  am guilty.""I am returning the money."" Save me, don't put me in jail.""Don't  file a lawsuit against me." It's not  because of that. He says, "It's not  like that.""I'm feeling moral  discomfort." He says, "We returned the  money." Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her  husband said they made investments  based on their own judgment, did not  receive any direction or special  information, and voluntarily repaid the  gains they obtained. I mean, the stock  hits its peak. Manipulation, preparing  for the manipulation heist. It hits the  exact peak. They are selling, and it's  a coincidence. They aren't getting info  by chance. The stocks will drop. They  aren't getting any info like that. I  mean, this place will crash. They  aren't getting the info. They are lying  right to our faces. They are openly  mocking this public, these people, the  people whose money they stole. They are  greedy, they are never satisfied. Their  gluttony never ends. We've seen their  mansions, their yachts, the entire  state payroll; the whole country  watches them. It feeds their entire  extended family. It transfers money to  their kin, pays them salaries. Deputy  ministers, ministries, roles in the  BRSA, embassies, they all sit in those  seats. They feed and fatten themselves,  they spend a fortune. They appoint 60  people to the private office and make  them civil servants without the KPSS  exam. They violate the nation's rights.  They steal the nation's positions and  shamelessly come and offer this defense . Shamelessly mocking our intelligence  like this. And that is how it is. Do  you know what they did next? They said  these things. They walked out of the  courthouse swinging their arms. They  jumped into their cars, their  ultra-luxury cars, and drove off. You  know, there are 5 people who returned  their money to the SDIF. Two of them  are these people. There are 3 more  people, I mean. And then there are  those who took 20 billion TL and fled.  I mean, among those who took 20 billion  TL and fled, look, they pulled off a 2  billion TL heist, they stole 2.2  billion TL from people—this person  I'm talking about, Osman Arıkan Nacar.  He fled with 20 billion TL. What did he  do with the 20 billion TL? They  inflated the stocks. They inflated the  stocks again. And these are types who  worked in health bureaucracy, the  Ministry of Health, in health  administration. They are all like that.  How is it that they amass incredible  wealth while in office? It’s not  something that can be explained by a  salary. Then they start companies,  health companies, old medical device  maintenance stuff, and the Ministry of  Labor and Social Security, where things  like drug reimbursements are hotspots  for corruption. A lot of money rotates  in the reimbursement of medical devices . So, they work there for years. They  have very strong backing. They work for  years. Then when they retire, when they  leave civil service, they have such  massive companies. Then they inflate  the stocks in the fund as much as they  can. They keep inflating them. And this  man, this very man, goes away. The  former undersecretary and e-data  partner Osman Arıkan Nacar takes 20  billion TL and disappears. Do you know  what happens next? It is alleged that  he vacationed in Bodrum with Ömer  Çelik. Zeynel Emre, the new party  spokesperson, announced it a short  while ago. He said that they were on  vacation with Ömer Çelik just  recently. They were on vacation. They  were vacationing together. In that  situation, now, we said it on our  broadcast yesterday, you are the AKP  spokesperson. Are you going to stay  silent? Are you going to act like this  question wasn't asked? Do you have the  right not to speak? We said it  yesterday, if someone from the IMM just  walked past such a person, they would  throw them in jail. You are vacationing  with a con artist who pulled off a 20  billion TL heist. Aren't you going to  say anything? Friends, do you know what  happened? Ömer Çelik went in front of  the cameras yesterday after the CEC  meeting. And he said nothing at all.  And shall I tell you something worse?  Not a single colleague there—I don't  know if they can be called colleagues —not a single journalist asked. I  mean, Mr. Ömer, there is this  allegation about you. No one said, " What do you have to say?" And he never  spoke about this subject. On the  contrary, he praised Erdoğan regarding  the fund scandal. "Erdoğan will go to  the end of this incident, we will  overcome this," and so on. Sir, Mr.  Erdoğan, there is a very serious  allegation about this person. Is it  down to this person to defend you? Now,  I don't know, you know your business,  but people will think like this. When  the spokesperson defends Erdoğan  regarding the fund scandal, his own  connection to the person who made a 20  billion TL hit came to light. I mean,  how are we supposed to believe you?  They say, "You say this for Erdoğan,  but Mr. Spokesperson, how can we  believe you?" But they really don't  care at all. "It will be pursued to the  end." No matter where it leads, the  spokesperson won't speak. Look, the  person responsible for informing the  press is not speaking, and he isn't  being asked, friends. And it's not even  being asked. Now, of course, it's not  being asked, but look, new parties will  ask for a while. They will start asking  this as well. As this man rose in the  bureaucracy, did he rise thanks to his  closeness to Ömer Çelik, I wonder?  Did this character exist in those  positions where big money flows, places  where billion-lira tenders are made,  thanks to his connection with Ömer  Çelik? This swindler...look, a new  party would even ask this, they really  would. If there is no talk, if no  statement is made, they will ask every  question. They will say, "Is he a proxy ?""Is this guy a bagman?" they will say . "What is his connection to Ömer  Çelik?" they will ask. "Whose bagman  is this guy?""Whose proxy is he?" they  will ask. Mr. Ömer, to you...speak up,  man. Is it really come to this? Is this  place that much of a banana republic?  The AKP spokesperson, the government  spokesperson, is not answering the  allegation against himself. Erdoğan is  actually doing that at the time. He is  dealing with this matter decisively.  Erdoğan criticizes the opposition, he  says. He declares the opposition  traitors and so on. The opposition says  harsh words and so on, and he talks, my  friend. Sense of shame, where are you?  Oh, sense of shame, where are you?  Where are you, really? He also says, " We are against political lynching."  Unbelievable. Truly unbelievable. Now,  of course, on the one hand, as we said,  Cevdet Yılmaz announced it. Regarding  that, how will they make the payment?  They presented a four-point framework  on that subject. In summary, the  process will be managed in a  transparent, fair, effective, and  fastest way possible. Point one, come  on, believe it; the process, look, " transparent" is the second word. There  is a four-point plan, right? " Transparent." Ömer Çelik won't speak;  the man won't answer the allegation  about himself. Here, the vice president  says it will be managed in a  transparent, fair, effective, and  fastest way possible. Look, I'm  underlining the word "fair" here too.  Do you know why? Because, fair  investment, fair asset management.  Hayati Yazıcı's son, Mustafa Yazıcı , is behind it, and look, his partner  committed suicide. His wealthy partner  committed suicide, according to the  allegations. We don't know if it was  murder. According to the allegation, he  committed suicide. He says, he says,  the process will be managed in a  transparent, fair, effective, and  fastest way possible. Action will be  taken by evaluating each fund's own  resources and the funds deposited into  the opened accounts, without using  resources from the Treasury. The  general principle is to make  distributions to investors in  proportion to their shares. For funds  subject to extraordinary liquidation  conditions, interim payments of  principal up to 1 million are planned.  Payments will be made by prioritizing  small investors and money market funds.  Because they also used the funds in the  money market, these so-called "local  and national" people are the ones who  smuggle that money abroad. Look, Emre  Tecme had a 200 million euro investment  just in Germany, but he was truly very  "local and national." Very, very local  and national. As we said, this fund  scandal is pregnant with many  developments, but on the other hand,  the AKP is trying to protect itself  through transfers. While trying to show  its strength on the agenda, the fight  within the AKP is truly heating up. Now , on one hand, we are talking to  various bureaucrats from the AKP.  Information is coming from them. They  state that there is a serious  preparation for a reckoning inside,  everyone is making moves against each  other, and that the moves of opposing  power centers to eliminate those with  vulnerabilities will intensify. Now,  for instance, what will come of this  two-minister allegation? Who will come  out? We are waiting with great  curiosity. Also, lawlessness. Look,  what do we see in all these  transactions? We see lawlessness, lack  of accountability, lack of transparency , and on the other hand, we see a  failure to comply with judicial rules —in other words, a failure to obey  the law. We see the rot of the justice  system in all these events. And there  is another very critical point there.  Now, as you know, Tayfun Kahraman has  been in prison for over 4.5 years due  to the Gezi trial. Can Atalay, Mine  Özerden, and similarly Çiğdem Mater.  Osman Kavala has been in prison for 10  years. And now, while laws were being  made during this process, it was said  in the commission that we would abide  by the decisions of the European Court  of Human Rights and the Constitutional  Court. Now, does this mean okay? It’s  like me saying, "I will not kill the  man." Yes. You shouldn't kill him  anyway, if you don't mind. Yes. You  will comply with the decisions of the  Constitutional Court. This is already  the case; the law mandates it, or you  have signed the European Convention on  Human Rights. I mean, if you don't want  to, you can withdraw; that's different.  But if you both sign it and say "I  won't comply"—if you both accept the  European Court of Human Rights and say  "I won't comply"—isn't that very  absurd? And they said they would comply , but they didn't. Look, Tayfun  Kahraman, Can Atalay, Mine Özerden,  Çiğdem Mater, and Osman Kavala are  still in prison. Despite the  Constitutional Court's decisions, Can  Atalay's parliamentary membership has  been revoked. In fact, the  Constitutional Court says he is an MP;  take him back. Meaning it says this man  is still an MP. They are violating the  constitution in Parliament. Now, the  reasoned decision regarding Tayfun  Kahraman has been announced. In the  reasoned decision, it was stated very  clearly that there was a violation of  rights and that he should be retried.  The translation of the ECHR decision  regarding Osman Kavala also reached the  court. That was also conveyed. Now a  decision is expected from there. They  could be released. They must be; these  people should regain their freedom. A  retrial decision must be issued. They  find ways to issue a retrial decision  but not release them, according to  their own interpretation of the law.  Because they do not comply with the  constitution or the Constitutional  Court. The Constitutional Court has  also made a statement. There is a  justification, if you really read it.  80%of the justification is about why  Constitutional Court rulings must be  obeyed. What does the Constitution say  about this? It explains that. It says,  "Constitutional Court, please recognize  us, please recognize us." This is the  state the Constitutional Court has  fallen into. This is the state. Now,  let's look. Ali Mahir Basarir said it  too, indeed. Release these people  immediately. If the Constitutional  Court has issued a violation ruling and  a local court is resisting, we have  reached a point where words fail. He  said it’s an unacceptable situation.  And he asked, "What are you waiting for ?" I mean, what are you waiting for  regarding this? They are keeping those  people in prison—those pure people,  those beautiful people fighting for  justice, those who have never had  anything to do with funds, money, or  wealth. On the contrary, they are  keeping people who have fought for  justice for the country and its  citizens, who have stood by poor  workers, poor families, and children,  and who have voluntarily stood by those  seeking justice. "Fundy Fatma" comes  with her husband. She gives her  statement and leaves waving her hands.  She is removed from some WhatsApp group . And now they have expelled her from  the AKP. Oh, the pity, the pity. They  stole 2.2 billion TL. You can't take  that much money out of a bank branch.  You have to load it onto two  semi-trucks. You have to park two  semi-trucks in front of the bank. Only  then can you load the money. Only then  can you take it out. I mean, now, look,  all of this is happening. We say there  is a double standard, don't we? How is  it at the Istanbul Metropolitan  Municipality? How was it most recently  in Mersin? How was it in other places?  When you look at all of them, when you  look at all these processes, what do  you see? Isn't it a double standard?  There is no rule of law, no legal  equality or anything. I mean, someone  stole 2.2 billion TL. They have  immunity, while on the other side,  there is every kind of persecution,  every kind of arrest, and every kind of  thing. By the way, we looked at  Esenyurt. Now look at the development  in Esenyurt. As you know, the mayor in  Esenyurt is Ahmet Özer. They removed  Ahmet Özer from office on grounds of " urban terror." Then he was released, a  trial happened, and so on, but they  didn't reinstate him. They are holding  onto Esenyurt. Who is in charge? The  trustee. The government-appointed  trustee in Esenyurt. Now that trustee  thinks he is the mayor himself. He puts  up banners everywhere as "Esenyurt  Mayor," and during Ramadan, he puts  plates out with his own name as " Esenyurt Mayor." Look, you weren't  elected, you are just a trustee. What's  gotten into you? But this is how they  were living. This was also drawing a  lot of attention. Look, Devlet Bahçeli  even said, "Let the Ahmets return to  duty." He is referring to Ahmet Özer  and Ahmet Türk. Despite that, they do  not reinstate them; they were not  reinstated. And the rent there is huge.  Everyone is curious about what kind of  business is going on in Esenyurt. Maybe  they are going to take the municipality , that’s why they aren’t doing it.  They are not reinstating Ahmet Özer to  his duty. They aren't even reinstating  an elected mayor, Ahmet Özer, to his  post. He is elected, after all. He is  elected. It is his right; that seat is  his right, but as we see in all of  these cases. What happened next? Look,  look at the story of these. He is  appointing an assistant. A trustee. A  trustee. Can Aksoy brings Yusuf Ulutaş  into office as his deputy, as deputy  mayor. A MASAK investigation is  conducted on Yusuf Ulutaş in the  report. They say he sent 212 million TL  to his sister. They take a look at the  212 million TL account movements. There  are 232 million TL of account movements  in one year. 232 million TL. Look, the  mayor is a trustee, mind you. Then they  searched his house. 450,854 dollars.  31,815 Euros, 2.58 [million TL],  580,000, 35 bracelets, 36 necklaces, 42  pairs of earrings, 17 rings, 9  wristbands; these come out of the safe.  4 watches, 2 Rolex brand watches, and  various pieces of jewelry were seized.  Three guns, one of them unlicensed,  were also found in the house, and now  when you look at the investigation here , you see this: Um, they were taking 20 %to give tenders to firms, they were  taking 20%. Do you know what was  reflected in their conversations? He  receives 3 million lira at a patisserie , that's there. Then the conversations  of other officials are caught on  wiretap. They also say, well, one asks,  how can we handle this? They put in the  wiretap records. They say all business  passes through that person, Yusuf, that  is. And in that conversation, they are  implying this. They say the key is with  Yusuf. The key to the municipality is  Yusuf Ulutaş. He is also the key for  Can. The money revolves around Yusuf.  So, an implication is understood here  that Can is also aware of this business . When you look, look, only there, look , only in Esenyurt, the trustee is  dismissed, and he is appointed there as  an assistant. There is an allegation  that the trustee and the mayor act  together. There is nothing against the  mayor, but they have taken him. Look,  it says, "According to the MASAK report , the total of the payments made to the  firms from which Ulutaş allegedly  demanded bribes is 248 million lira."  The transfer he made to his sister,  that is, is 212,150,000. Do you see the  scam? What a huge scam, really. Now,  Ahmet Özer didn't steal or embezzle  anything. And he is not in his position . These are in office. These were  placed in their stead. Is this the  system, then? They weren't elected. Are  they there just to sit and rob, to  profit, and to strike money from there?  So, is that why these trustees are  being appointed? Is this why people's  right to vote, right to election, is  being usurped? I mean, it's really  terrible. This is how people's right to  choose the people who will govern them,  their most democratic rights, are being  usurped. Goodbye.

Hani bu life is life vardır ya onun nasıl yapıldığını yapmışlar doğu bloğunda işte adamlar diyor ki neydi bu grubun adı ya? Scorpios muydu? Life is life var ya işte stüdyoya giriyorlar. O life'ı bulana kadar neler çektiklerini buluyorlar. En sonunda bir şey alıyorlar. Eee bir anda life is life geliyor. Bomba gibi bir reklam. Şimdi ilginç bir şey yaşandı İtalya'da. Biraz teknoloji dünyasını ihmal ediyoruz. Fon Mondi konuşarak. Eee, o da İtalyan Başbakanı Georgia Meloni sesini deep fake'lere karşı tescil ettirmek için başvurmuş. Şimdi Tolga hocayla biraz bunu konuşalım. Eee, Tolga hocam bu deep fake meselesi çok ilginç. Artık gerçekliğin tamamen öldüğü bir çağa geldik. Yani çünkü görüntü üretebiliyorsun, ses üretebiliyorsun. İtalyan başbakanı da sesini tescil ettiriyor. Ne demek tescil ettirmek? >> Şöyle eee, aslında çok basit bir şey yaptı. 4 saniyelik bir eee sesini ya sadece şey demiş. Eee ben eee George Elelon demiş ve bunu eee Avrupa Fikir eee Hakları Kurumuna eee diyor ki ben bunu sesimi dijital olarak bunu bir dijital varlık olarak kaydettirmek istiyorum. Peki bunu neden yapıyor? Her şeyden önce aslında eee Georgia Meleni ve ekibini eee tebrik etmemiz lazım. Çünkü hep bunu şunu konuşuyoruz. Teknoloji önden gidiyor. Kanunlar birazcık daha arkadan geliyor. Eee, İtalya'da 2027 yılında seçimler var ve eğer, eee, önümüzdeki yıllarda sadece İtalya'da değil, dünyanın herhangi bir yerindeki bir seçimde deep fake'le karşılaşılmazsa aslında bizim buna şaşırmamız gerekiyor. Bununla karşılaşacakları çok aşikar ve buna bunun için aslında önlem alıyorlar. Kanunların bir adım önüne geçiyorlar. Eee, çünkü şöyle düşünün, eee, bunu dijital varlık olarak kaydettirdikten sonra acaba bunu kaydettirmeyen politikacıyla Georgia Meloni arasında ne fark var diyeceksiniz. Bu, bunun ikisi arasında şöyle bir fark var. Eğer deep fake'iniz çıkarsa siz bununla ilgili mahkemeye veya herhangi bir kuruma gittiğinizde üçüncü bir kişinin yorumuna ve bununla ilgili onun değerlendirmesini beklemek zorundasınız veya onun yorumuna aslında birazcık mahkum kalıyorsunuz. Ancak dijital olarak varlığınızı kabul ettirdiğiniz zaman ben bunun burada kullanılmasını istemiyorum dediğiniz anda aslında hiçbir şekilde ekspres bir şekilde aslında bunun kaldırılmasına yol açmış oluyorsunuz ki bu aslında çok güzel bir şey eee kanunlar şu anda bunun biraz gerisinde kaldığı için bir adım öne geçmiş durumdalar. Eee ancak burada insanların aklına başka bir soru geliyor. Acaba e çünkü hani bunu şöyle düşünün. eee, aynı bir, eee, müzik gibi yani sizin müzik parçanız gibi, kayıtlı müzik parçanız gibi telifi olan veya filmin parçası gibi istediğiniz yerden kaldırtabiliyorsunuz. Çünkü telifi sizde. Acaba telif kendisinde diye yaptığınız bir röportajdaki bir parçayı da kaldırabilir misiniz diye soracak olursanız burada da Avrupa Birliği Adalet Komisyonu'nun verdiği bir karar var. Eee, basın özgürlüğü eee, hepsinin üzerinde olduğu için böyle bir şey yapamıyor. Yani deep fake'lere müdahale edebiliyor. Ancak diğer tarafta müdahale olamayacak. Şimdi benim oğlan Mavi'ye bir Aslan ablası geçen gün bir gözlük hediye etti. Bu AI gözlükler var ya şeyden Rayban değil mi? Takıyorsunuz yan tarafında kamera var ve işte basıyorsun kaydediyor kayıt yapıyor. Ama mesela Mavi dikkat ediyor işte diyor ki ya ben bunu okula şey yapamam, götüremem etik olarak kendisi. Ama buna şimdi anladığım kadarıyla eee Norveç yasaklamış kamusal alanlarda bu gözlüklerin kullanılmasını. Şimdi bu gözlüklerle ilgili şurasında kayda girdiğiniz zaman bir ışık yanıyor ama mesela orayı kapatıyorlarmış. O ışık meselesini kimse görmesin diye. >> Eee bence önemli. Yavaş yavaş hayatımıza böyle şeyler de girmeye başladı. Eee niye almışlar bu kararı? Tam olarak ne diyorlar? >> Aslında bunun çerçevesini şöyle çizmekte fayda var. Eee Cüneyt Bey, eee biz aslında şu anda bir kırılım yaşıyoruz. Bugüne kadar biz bilgisayarla klavye üzerin klavyeyle ve mouse'la aslında iletişime geçiyorduk ve yazıyorduk. Ancak artık eee yapay zeka sayesinde eee cihazlar bizi konuştuğumuz doğal dillerimizde algılayabiliyorlar, anlıyorlar, komutlar alıyorlar ve işlem gerçekleştirebiliyorlar. Bu yüzden gözlük gibi aslında bilgisayar aslında gözlük olarak taktığımız bilgisayar içinde bir işletim sistemi var. Arkasında yapay zeka var. Biz burada ona komut verebiliyoruz ve aynı zamanda bizim gördüğümüzü de görüyor. Şimdi sorun bu tarafta. Eee, Norveç'in, eee, dijitalleşme ve, eee, kamu yönetimi bakanlığı yasaklamadı henüz. Ancak bununla ilgili kanun çalışması yaptığını açıkladı. Fakat okullarda yasakladı. Yani OSA'daki okullarda şu anda yasak. Eylül ayından beri eee, bu gözlükler yasaklandı. Peki bu neden bizim için önemli? Hani eee, şöyle düşünün. bir kamera var ve kamera bizi çekiyor. Yani ben şu anda bu ofisten çıksam ve 100 metre yürüsem 100 metrenin 95 metresinde kayıtlı olduğumu biliyorum. Eee, bakkalın, marketin veya herhangi bir iş yerinin kamerası veya güvenlik kameraları zaten beni kaydediyor. Peki bunun önemi ne derseniz bunun önemi şu. Arka planda aslında sadece kaydetmiyor. Eee, kaydettikten sonra bunları işleyebilecek bir şekilde arka planda yapay zeka ve buluttan veri çekebiliyor. Bu görüntülerle ilgili şöyle düşünün Cüneyt Bey, bir kafede oturuyorsunuz. Ben size yaklaşıyorum ve kameram sizi görüyor. Yani gözlüğüm bu gözlükten taktığımı düşünün. Sizin görüntünüzden ben isminizi bulabilirim ve aynı zamanda eee arka planda araştırma yapıp mesela sizin 2005 yılında yaptığınız bir röportajdan örnek vererek siz bu soruyu sormuştunuz karşılığında bu gelmiş diye. Sizin bile hatırlamadığınız bir eee veriyi size sunabilirim sizinle ilgili. Bu arada bu çok asimetrik bir güç aslında. Yani çok ciddi bir şekilde bir şey sağlıyorum ve Fransa'da şu anda bu asimetrik güce karşı eee şöyle davalar var. Fransız savcılığının elinde iş yerinde eee gözlük takanlarla gözlük takmayanlar eee arasında bu asimetrik güç savaşı olduğu için gözlük takılmasının iş yerlerinde yasaklanması ile ilgili davalardan eee bahsediliyor. Eee önümüzdeki yıllarda da hani eee böyle şeylerin yasaklandığını başka ülkelerin de bu eee trende katıldığını görmemiz hiç sürpriz olmayacak bizler için. >> Ya Tolga hocam vallahi 2015'te New York'a gittim. Yani bir startup projesi olarak tabii o zaman gözlük yok. Hatta bunu geçen gün anlattım. Dedim ki ya o zaman arttırılmış gerçeklik konuşuluyor. Ya bir uygulama yazsak hani biz gözümüzde bir şey görüyoruz ama telefonu kaldırdığımızda karşımızda ne bileyim buradaki binada atılan tweet'i görsek, Instagram'ı görsek ya da ne bileyim New York Times'da o binayla ilgili çıkan haberi görsek, bilmem ne yapsak diye. Sonra dedim ki ya bu şimdi yarın bir gün elimizde patlar uğraşmayalım. Gazeteciliğe döndük ya. Onun yerine YouTube kanalına döndük. Keşke bunu yapsaymışım bak. Şu anda belki de gerçekten dünya yani metaya 5 yıl önce satmıştık belki böyle bir şeye girsek ama tabii fikir hiçbir şeyi ifade etmiyor. Teknoloji dünyasında önemli olan hayata geçirmek. Hayata geçirmediğiniz sürece öyle anı olarak anlatıyorsunuz. Benim de aklıma gelmişti ya diye söylüyorsunuz. Çok teşekkür ederim. Ekleyeceğiniz bir şey var mı? >> Çok teşekkürler. Sağ olun Cennet Bey. >> Sağ olun. Kenan sanırım bir son dakika gelişmesi var. İstanbul Başsavcılığından bir açıklama yapıldı. Bu e güncel olaylarla ilgili eee ne diyor açıklamada? >> Biliyorsunuz bu fon fon meselesi çıktıktan sonra ya işte soruşturmalar yapılmıyor, eksikti, oydu, buydu. Bir sürü sosyal medyada yani hesabı olan herkes bir şey yazıyor aslında. Savcılık bence bunun önüne geçmek için bir fon soruşturması kapsamında bir açıklaması var. diyor ki, "Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, SPK, Borsa İstanbul merkezi kayıt sistemi ile ilgili diğer kurum ve kuruluşlardan temin edilen bilgi ve belgeleri titizlikle inceliyor. Bununla birlikte bazı sosyal medya platformlarında, dijital mecralarda soruşturmanın içeriğiyle ilişkin gerçeği yansıtmayan birçok ifadeler kullanılıyor di" diyor ve dezenformasyon yapılıyor. Bunları görüyoruz diyor. eee gerçeğe aykırı bilgiler yayanlara da diyor Türk Ceza Kanunu 217. maddesi halkı yanıltıcı bilgiyi alenen yayma suçlamasıyla soruşturma başlatılacaktır. Adli işlem yapılacaktır diye bir açıklama yapmış. Aslında bizim hep 10 gündür söylediğimiz şeyi söylüyor. Çok böyle bir herkes bir şey yazıyor, bir şey konuşuyor, farklı hesaplar onlar bunlar. Onlara önlem için Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı da böyle bir uygulama yapıyor. >> Peki, çok teşekkür ederim. Evet, bugün yayına biraz erken başladık. E Madrid'e gidiyorum. O yüzden erken canlı yayın yaptık. E Madrid'ten yarın belki bağlanmaya çalışacağım. Ben yayın saati sırasında yolculukta olacağım. Bitrende olacağım ama bağlanabilirsem bağlanacağım. Eee, pazartesi günü Brüksel'de olacağız. Avrupa Birliği ile ilgili Deik'in önemli bir toplantısı var. İki gün sürecek. Onu takip edeceğiz. Sonrasında kana geçmeyi planlıyorum. Orada da MIP'in var. MPIM biliyorsunuz dizi sektörünün, film sektörünün kalbinin attığı bir fuar. Ne zamandır gitmiyordum. Daha önce en son gittiğimde sanırım Nuri Bilge Ceylan'la bir söyleşi yapmıştık. Bayağı olmuş bakın gitmeyeli. Eee ben de hem bir yapımcı olarak hem de bir gazeteci olarak oraya gidip belki oradan da bir biraz farklı bir hava anlatayım size. Hep aynı şeyleri konuşuyoruz, duruyoruz. Biraz havanız değişsin istiyorum. Bizim de havamız değişir belki de. O yüzden bir beğen tuşuna basarsanız çok sevinirim. Beğeni alı, beğen like'ınızı alırım. Eee, ayrıca eee özellikle eee katıl tuşuyla bize destek olabilirsiniz. İşbirlikleri için Kenan@DNO TV'ye yazabilirsiniz. Eee, onun dışında da eee, paylaşırsanız, yorum yazarsanız çok çok seviniriz. Evet, yarın saat 12:00'de ben Manc'ten trenlenen bağlanmaya çalışacağım. Eee, ama ben olmasam da Kenan karşınızda olacak. Eee, yeni bir yayında buluşuncaya kadar kadın sağlacakla değil. İspanya'dan, >> Almanya'dan, >> Yunanistan'dan, Lepkoşa'dan, Paris'ten, >> Silikon Visi'den, NASA'dan, Şili'den, >> Japonya'dan, >> Amsterdam'a geldik. Şam'a geldik. Trablus Havaalanında. >> Evet. Buz gibi bir havada New York'un göbeğinde Harlem tempindeyiz. Türk Irak sınırındayız. Kapkaranlık Bağdat'ın içindeyiz. >> Kirin biraz dışındayız. Bombalanmış alanlar görüyorsunuz. Gerçek bir savaşın tam ortasındayız. Burası Guantanamo, ınterpol binası, Haberdin limanı. Bazen güldük programda. Bazen yaşananlar karşısında gözyaşlarımızı siz de ben de zor tuttuk. Ben Cüneyt Özdemir. Hafta içi her gün saat 12'de YouTube'dan gündemi canlı yorumluyorum.

items.name: Murat Yetkin
items.title: Erdoğan İzmir’i oyla alamamıştı, CHP oylarıyla seçilen Cemil Tugay’ı AK Partiye aldı. - Murat Yetkin
items.transkript: Hello everyone. I offer my respects and  wish you a beautiful day. In Turkish  political history, the shifting of  balances through these political  transfers is not a new phenomenon.  Governments have been formed before.  Governments have fallen. Erdoğan,  Tayyip Erdoğan, had said that when he  first came to power, he would put an  end to these political transfers. Yet  what we are seeing right now, what we  see these days, is truly on a scale  that rivals the examples of the past. I  am talking about İzmir Mayor,  Metropolitan Mayor Cemil Tugay, joining  the Justice and Development Party today . Because the actual situation at hand  is that Cemil Tugay, with the votes he  received from Republican People's Party  voters or opposition voters in general  in the 2024 elections, effectively  served the İzmir Metropolitan  Municipality on a silver platter to  President and Justice and Development  Party Chairman Erdoğan, to Tayyip  Erdoğan. I mean, this is a truly rare  event. Because the Justice and  Development Party has never been able  to win İzmir since it was founded.  Look, in the latest 2024 local  elections, the total vote for the  People's Alliance—that is, the  Justice and Development Party, the  Nationalist Movement Party, and the  other parties in the People's Alliance —was 37%. He won with 49%. He won  with 49%of the vote. Those votes are  now effectively votes cast for the  Justice and Development Party. Now,  here, of course, we have what Özgür  Özel, the new party leader Özgür  Özel, said in the group meeting  yesterday. He called him a traitor. He  must have given up hope by now. I mean,  after the "Absolute Nullity" incident  earlier, of course...He had resigned  from the Republican People's Party. He  had remained independent. He visited  the President on September 30th. He  visited Erdoğan. Then he resigned from  the Atatürkist Thought Association and  turned off his phone. I suppose as of  yesterday, Özel finally cut him off.  He lost hope, which is why he called  him a traitor. Then, in the evening,  something else interesting happened. In  the evening hours, yesterday, the  Justice and Development Party released  a propaganda video on their social  media accounts. In this video, the  camera moves upwards from piles of  trash that supposedly represent İzmir,  and flowers start blooming. Then, we  see—meanwhile, the İzmir March is  playing. An hourglass is turning, and  the news that Cemil Tugay would join  them was being announced almost as if  it were a gift. Upon this, he used a  certain word. Özgür Özel used a  phrase. He said, "Just as Anatolia was  not surrendered when signatures were  forced from 'bedmaya'[base-born]  individuals before, now in İzmir, they  are forcing a 'bedmaya' to sign with  offers and threats.""Bedmaya" is a word  that comes from Persian. It means " rotten-natured" or "bad-blooded." Some  dictionaries translate it as "tainted"  or "ignoble," but "bedmaya" means of a  corrupt nature. Who is he saying this  to? He is saying this to Cemil Tugay.  Now, let's look at both sides of the  coin here. Okay. Can Cemil Tugay be  called a traitor? From the perspective  of Republican People's Party voters and  İzmir voters, it can be said that he  betrayed them. Perhaps, but it was also  Özgür Özel who insisted on making  Cemil Tugay the candidate in the 2024  elections. He was the party chairman at  that time. Now, this obviously brings  other things to light, I mean. Yes. The  Republican People's Party has come  under a major attack. Especially the  investigations launched into İmamoğlu  and the municipalities, but what was  the main point? Absolute Nullity.  Absolute Nullity was a fracture, a  division. A new party was founded. Then  Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu took the helm of  the Republican People's Party by a  court decision. The ruling power  effectively scattered the ranks of the  main opposition. Of course, there are  also judicial rulings as well. And the  transfers were the icing on the cake  for this. As we always say, the main  target is Istanbul. The main target is  Istanbul. To take control of the  majority in the Istanbul Metropolitan  Municipality with these transfers, with  the help of detentions, and to take  over Istanbul and its resources again  before the elections—before the  general and presidential elections— that is, to seize what they could not  win through votes by using such  transfers. But of course, Izmir,  friends, Izmir is important; it has a  spiritual value, especially for the  Republican People's Party, for  left-wing voters, and generally for the  opposition and anti-AK Party voters.  When you asked CHP supporters, they  used to say, "it's our stronghold," and  so on. Now, it's not through votes, but  through transfers, I mean...Erdoğan  could not get the consent of the voters  in Izmir, but he went and did something . He took Cemil Tugay into the party.  Now there is such a situation at hand.  Now, you might ask, is this a victory?  I mean, Ali Mahir Başarır said, "You  are a plastic surgeon.""Go change your  face.""You won't be able to show your  face in public in Izmir," and so on.  These are fine, these might be words  said to soothe some people's hearts,  but they don't solve the problem. They  don't solve the problem. The problem,  of course, comes down to one thing. How  were the candidate selections made? We  discussed this in many places before,  didn't we? We talked about those who  changed sides in various districts in  Istanbul. And then, we talked about the  Uşak Municipality scandal. We asked, " Where do you find these people?" We  asked again in the Antalya Metropolitan  Municipality incident. Now, Cemil Tugay , while there were other candidates... look, this also has a painful aspect.  In another way. Now, Tunç Soyer was  the previous mayor, the Mayor of Izmir  Metropolitan Municipality. Do you know  what percentage he won with? In 2019,  he won with 58%, almost 60%, against  the People's Alliance. They did not  make him a candidate. The elected  administration of the Republican  People's Party, that is, Özgür  Özel's management. Why? They said  Tunç Soyer voted for Kemal  Kılıçdaroğlu. Meanwhile, Cemil  Tugay was the Mayor of Karşıyaka at  the time. He had voted for the Özgür  Özel list, but there was indeed a  backlash. There was a backlash. There  was also backlash against Tunç Soyer,  to be fair. But there was also backlash  against making Cemil Tugay the  candidate. It’s clear, but the  headquarters put its weight behind it.  They went with Cemil Tugay, saying he  was the one appearing in the polls. Now  what is being said about him? He is  called a traitor, he is called  malicious. Meaning, they say he is  rotten to the core. Now, don't you  think something is going wrong here? I  mean, there is something that is  clearly visible. Now, I don't mean to  say this. The Izmir voter, and even the  Istanbul voter, let's say. The Ankara  voter also knows what to do. They know  what they will do. But this situation  truly shows, for the opposition,  especially for the Republican People's  Party and the New Party, what a serious  point their candidate selection process  has reached. It shows what state it has  reached. I mean, sure, it's fine, we  see they selected candidates with  artificial intelligence, we see they  used polls. I mean, it's something else , something different. Yes. Both the  Republican People's Party and the new  party are under attack; there is a  judicial situation. There is judicial  pressure, on one hand, operations are  being conducted on their municipalities  every day, but the candidates are out  there. I mean, these things are also  visible. I mean, it's impossible to  ignore this. Now, does this serve any  purpose? No. It is of no use at this  point. I mean, what's done is done, the  moment has passed. But look, another  major city, and it's also from the  Aegean. The first had emerged in Aydin.  The second major city transfer also  came from the Aegean. And the Aegean  was something, right? Like the fortress  of the secular, democratic, republican  voter and so on. Well, a fortress is  fine, but winning the Izmir  municipality does not mean winning  Izmir. We will wait for the election.  The saying is true in that respect. It  is true in that regard. The same can be  said for Istanbul, but I ask these  questions for this reason. I mean, is  this a victory from the Justice and  Development Party's perspective? I  don't know, we will see in the election . We will see in the election, but we  can criticize the thing. Erdogan  trampled on all his principles and is  gaining ground through political  transfers. We can say this. But I had  stopped at Tunc Soyer. I will continue  there. I mean, while the badge was  being pinned on Cemil Tugay, and while  President Erdogan was pinning the AK  Party badge, and right behind him,  while Cemil Tugay was heaping praise on  Erdogan, saying things like "the AK  Party is the voice of the voiceless,"  let's also talk about the fact that  just 23 months ago he was saying  everything he could against the AK  Party, right? Since we started talking,  do you know what was happening? Tunc  Soyer had been in Buca prison for 15  months. For 15 months, and in his own  words, he was dealing with backup  lawsuits. Meaning if he was acquitted  or released in one case, the next case  would kick in. This is the situation we  are in. We are in such a situation. I  mean, on one hand, politicians are  truly undermining politics. I mean,  like they say, they are damaging the  reputation of politics and so on. Well,  with these people around, there is no  need for anything else. Of course, I  also observed this today at the  ceremony at the Justice and Development  Party Headquarters; you can look at the  footage yourselves. The heavyweights of  the AK Party looked quite sour. Okay,  they applaud when Erdogan says  something, but there is that famous  saying in politics. Those who wait at  the dervish lodge get to eat the soup.  Meaning if you have enough patience,  perseverance, and stand firm,  eventually you will see the benefit of  it. But right now, Erdogan is running  politics entirely with politicians  recruited from the Republican People's  Party and other opposition parties. On  the other hand, Nationalist Movement  Party leader Devlet Bahceli is giving  messages like "it won't work without  you." Oh, and there is also the latest  message from Devlet Bahçeli, you know,  saying Erdoğan must absolutely be  elected for a 3rd time. When you look  between the lines, you see something  else as well. Between the lines, there  is actually a message to the DEM Party.  It’s as if he’s saying, "Look, if  you don't elect Erdoğan, forget about  this...this terror-free Turkey thing  and all that." So, we are putting all  of these together. Let me give you a  few more pieces of news. An important  one: in the last 3 days, three ships  owned by Turks in the Black Sea were  hit by drones. Ukraine is suspected,  but it's not certain. One of them sank.  No Turkish citizens died, but it is  reported that 10 people died on the  sunken ship. They are not Turkish  citizens. Bulgarian authorities also  announced this. It has also put the  world on alert, saying the Black Sea is  about to explode. It’s an important  matter. Uh, one more thing: Fatma  Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband  İlyas Kaya were finally summoned to  testify. 12 days have passed since then . I mean, while dawn raids are still  being carried out against mayors, they  were just summoned to testify. I  followed up on something like this. I  investigated a bit, you know, Justice  Minister Akın Gürlek said it’s  double—well, it’s not just him  saying it, the law says so. Only if  they pay double the amount of their  exorbitant gains can they benefit from  effective remorse. The Kaya couple paid  that 2.2 billion by deducting the  interest. Ah, there is such a situation , sir. How much of that, uh, that  non-exorbitant, how much was legal  earnings has not been determined yet. I  received an answer that this will be  applied not just for them but for  others once it is determined. One, uh,  more topic. Ömer Çelik. There were  allegations made about Ömer Çelik.  Zeynel Emre, the Republican People's  Party spokesperson. He asked, "Did you  go abroad with this Osman Arıkan Nacar ?" He held a press conference saying, " It is rumored that this man smuggled 20  billion liras abroad," and so on.  Following the Justice and Development  Party's Central Executive Board meeting , Ömer Çelik was asked about this by  reporters. There are such allegations  against you. What do you say? He didn't  directly get into that topic. He said  if anyone has information or documents,  they should go to the Ministry of  Justice, the Ministry of Treasury, or  whichever authority they should provide  it to. "I can't deal with these," he  said. He said something like that. I am  reading from here, he also said about  Özgür Özel: He said, "I will not  give credit to a person who has let his  own party fall into the hands of  profiteers and swindlers, especially  when what his own party members say  about him is out there." Anyway, this  debate is continuing. But it is truly  not the political news of the day. In  the future, we will see that this Izmir  incident was a breaking point for both  the government and the opposition. This  Izmir incident could be considered a  turning point in the future for both  the government and the opposition. In  Turkey's recent political history.  Hoping to be with you again in a new  broadcast, goodbye.
